formal_statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 6 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∀ i : Fin 4, ∑ j, t (i, j) = 0) ∧ (∑ f : Fin 4 ↪ Fin 6, ∏ i, (1 + t (i, f i))) = 360) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 8
plain_statement: SEARCH GAP, possibly false: exhibit a linear space L of 4 x 6 complex matrices of dimension exactly 8 in which every row of every element sums to zero, and on which the sum, over all injections f of the 4 rows into the 6 columns, of the product of (1 + t(i, f(i))) stays equal to 360, its value at t = 0 (equivalently all sums of k x k subpermanents vanish on L). With zero row sums, dimension 7 is on our record (unchecked, exact arithmetic) and nothing larger is known. A witness is an explicit basis; a refutation is the bound 7.
title: Search: a level space of 4 x 6 complex matrices with zero row sums of dimension 8
